ideas.title: Telltales: trim a tall sail whose flow is solved in 3D every frame
ideas.goal: The player sails the cart along the beach by easing and hauling the sheet with Lumi's beak and watching two wool threads on the luff: both streaming, it pulls; the lee one lifting and twirling, it luffs and the cart slows. Gusts and the cart's own speed swing the apparent wind, so the trim never sits still: a skill you feel in your hands.
ideas.toward: The land yacht step of the road: the sail's force and the trim read both come from one 3D flow, so the cart moves by its sail before the dynamo goes on.
ideas.idea: No 2D stand-in and no refresh: the sail is a body in a 3D WaterLily box on the GPU (Mantle) that rides with the cart and steps EVERY frame, with the apparent wind as its inflow and the sheet angle turning the body; the force is read every step, so a sheet pull answers in the time the real flow takes to re-attach (about two chords of wind), not on a timer. Measured this session: 32 cells per chord resolve the luff (2D: lift -0.21 at 0 deg, 0.60 at 5, 1.27 at 10), but a short AR-2 sail in 3D loses it (0.14 at 5 deg rising smoothly to 0.52 at 30), so the game's sail is tall like a real land yacht's (AR 4) and step 1 is checking that the luff appears in 3D there; whatever the 3D flow does is what the player gets. Sized to keep real time: a 2.5 m chord in a 4-6 m/s breeze is 2-3 steps of 5 ms a frame. The telltales are threads advected in that same 3D velocity field. Someone watching sees a limp sail snap full, both threads stream back and the cart lurch off with three pony-sized friends.
ideas.form: A plugin: the cart with a mast and a patched sail on the beach in Jump in, sheet in/out; a traced film of the sail filling, threads streaming and the cart going.

ideas.title: Lay the road under a rolling cart: grab the plank behind, drop it in front
ideas.goal: The cart creeps across soft sand on four planks; the player, as Lumi, snatches each plank the back wheels have just left, runs it forward and drops it before the front wheels roll off the end. Too slow and a wheel drops off and bogs; a plank dropped crooked see-saws under the wheel. Frantic, funny, and you get better at it.
ideas.toward: The plank road and the cart (todo #755): wheels on planks vs sand, planks that sink and tilt by the sand, Lumi's beak really carrying the plank.
ideas.idea: physics/sandfield.jl already rests a plank on sand by Bekker pressure and see-saws it under a load; the wheels roll on whatever is under them (plank or sand by contact) and sink by wheelsand.jl. Lumi holds the plank by its end at the beak (beak_tips), its weight pulls the head down, and it drops where Lumi lets go, tilting into the sand. Someone watching sees a bird sprint back and forth under a creaking cart, planks thumping down, sand squeezing out from under them, until a wheel drops off the end and the cart lurches into the sand.
ideas.form: A play mode on the dune in Jump in with the cart, planks as assets; a film of a run that ends in a bog.

ideas.title: A handcar: two friends pump a see-saw lever and the crank turns the wheels
ideas.goal: Before the cart has a motor the friends drive it themselves: two ponies at the ends of a see-saw lever, a crank to the axle, a flywheel. The player sets their rhythm; in time the cart rolls along the plank road, out of time the crank sticks on its dead centre and they bob uselessly until someone kicks the flywheel.
ideas.toward: Wheels, axle, frame and gears on the road, and friends that work the machine with their bodies (the moment: 'the friends get off and push').
ideas.idea: Rigid bodies with joints (PrintSim: hinges, a crank and connecting rod, wheels on planks), driven only by the friends' weight shifting onto the lever ends as they rise and drop, by their real masses. A single crank really has two dead centres, a flywheel's inertia carries it through, and the gear ratio decides between a fast cart on the flat and one that climbs. Someone watching sees two ponies see-saw up and down in a rhythm, the flywheel spin up, the cart trundle off, then stall at the bottom of the dune.
ideas.form: A machine built on the cart's frame, played in Jump in; a film of the ponies pumping it along the beach.

ideas.title: Heave: the friends lean, brace and slip as they rock the cart out of its rut
ideas.goal: The loaded cart bogs in its own rut; Lumi calls the rhythm by pushing itself, and the friends join on the beat: in phase, the cart rocks further each time until it climbs out; out of phase it only digs deeper. A cooperative timing game against the sand.
ideas.toward: The friends pushing at the end of the big goal's moment, with real bodies.
ideas.idea: Each friend's push goes through its feet: a foot plants on the sand field, holds while the push is below what the sand bears (wheelsand.jl's foot law), and slides back in a spray when it is not; the body leans to put its weight behind the push, and that lean is the pose. Their masses (#745) and the rut the wheels cut (sandfield.jl) set how far each heave gets; the cart rolls back by gravity between heaves, so pushes in phase add up like a swing. Someone watching sees four bodies lean in, feet skid and dig, the cart rock, rock, and pop free.
ideas.form: A step of the cart plugin with the friends as pushers; a film of a cart freed.

ideas.title: The friends ride the cart down the dune and steer by leaning
ideas.goal: From the top of the dune the cart coasts down with the friends aboard; it has no steering, so the player shifts the friends left and right, their weight loads one pair of wheels, those sink deeper and drag, and the cart turns. A sledge ride where the crew is the wheel.
ideas.toward: The cart as a whole machine on sand with the friends riding along: the last step of the road, before it has power.
ideas.idea: The cart is a rigid body on four wheels; each wheel's sinkage and drag come from its own load in the sand field, so moving a 200 kg friend to one side really changes the drag left vs right and yaws the cart. Ruts from earlier runs pull the wheels in. Someone watching sees three friends lean like bobsledders, the cart weave down the dune leaving S-shaped ruts, and tip a friend off on a hard turn.
ideas.form: A play mode on the dune; a film down the dune from a following camera.
